verdict.rationale: Superpowers has no llms.txt of its own: the only llms.txt found belongs to GitHub, and the .md docs probe returned 404. However, the product is itself a body of agent-oriented markdown. Skills are written as documentation for agents and shared verbatim across harnesses, served as raw SKILL.md files, and include a porting guide. A community report also describes the Codex/OpenCode install as an agent following install instructions. missing for 10: a first-party llms.txt or docs-index for agents, explicit documentation on pointing an arbitrary agent at the docs, independent corroboration of the agent-driven install flow.
